translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai boht meharban hai
qasam hai unn ( farishton ) ki jo ( kafiron ki rooh ) sakhti say kheenchtay hain ,
aur jo ( mominon ki rooh ki ) girah narmi say khol detay hain ,
phir ( fizza mein ) tertay huye jatay hain ,
phir tezi say lapaktay hain ,
phir jo hukum milta hai , uss ( ko poora kernay ) ka intizam kertay hain ,
kay jiss din bhonchal ( her cheez ko ) halla daalay ga ,
phir uss kay baad aik aur jhatka aaye ga ,
uss din boht say dil laraz rahey hon gay ,
unn ki aankhen jhuki hoi hon gi .
yeh ( kafir log ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya hum pehli wali halat per loata diye jayen gay ?
kiya uss waqt jab hum boseedah haddiyon mein tabdeel hochukay hon gay ?
kehtay hain kay :  agar aisa huwa to yeh baray ghatay ki wapsi hogi .
haqeeqat to yeh hai kay woh bus aik zor ki aawaz hogi ,
jiss kay baad woh achanak aik khulay meydan mein hon gay .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) kiya tumhen musa ka waqiaa phoncha hai ?
jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unhen toowa ki muqaddas wadi mein aawaz di thi
kay :  firon kay paas chalay jao , uss ney boht sarkashi ikhtiyar ker rakhi hai .
aur uss say kaho kay kiya tumhen yeh khuwaish hai kay tum sanwar jao-?
aur yeh kay mein tumhen tumharay perwerdigar ka raasta dikhaon to tumharay dil mein khof peda hojaye-?
chunacheh musa ney uss ko bari zabardast nishani dikhai ,
phir bhi uss ney ( unhen ) jhutlaya , aur kehna nahi maana ,
phir dorr dhoop kernay kay liye palta ,
phir sabb ko ikattha kiya , aur aawaz lagai
aur kaha kay :  mein tumhara aalaa darjay ka perwerdigar hun .
nateeja yeh huwa kay Allah ney ussay aakhirat aur duniya kay azab mein pakar liya .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss waqaey mein uss shaks kay liye bari ibrat hai jo Allah ka khof dil mein rakhta ho .
. ( insano ! ) kiya tumhen peda kerna ziyada mushkil hai , ya aasman ko-?   uss ko Allah ney banaya hai ,
uss ki bulandi uthai hai , phir ussay theek kiya hai ,
aur uss ki raat ko andheri banaya hai , aur uss kay din ki dhoop bahir nikal di hai ,
aur zameen ko uss kay baad bicha diya hai ,
uss mein say uss ka paani aur uss ka chara nikala hai ,
aur paharon ko gaarr diya hai ,
takay tumhen aur tumharay maweshiyon ko faeeda phonchaye .
phir jab woh sabb say bara hangama barpa hoga ,
jiss din insan apna sara kiya dhara yaad keray ga ,
aur dozakh her dekhney walay kay samney zahir kerdi jaye gi ,
to woh jiss ney sarkashi ki thi ,
aur duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh di thi ,
to dozakh hi uss ka thikana hogi .
lekin woh jo apney perwerdigar kay samney kharra honey ka khof rakhta tha , aur apney nafs ko buri khuwaishaat say rokta tha ,
to jannat hi uss ka thikana hogi .
yeh log tum say qayamat ki gharri kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay woh kab qaeem hogi ?
tumhara yeh baat biyan kernay say kiya kaam-?
iss ka ilm to tumharay perwerdigar per khatam hai .
jo shaks uss say darta ho , tum to sirf uss ko khabrdar kernay walay ho .
jiss din yeh uss ko dekh len gay , uss din enhen aisa maloom hoga jaisay woh ( duniya mein ya qabar mein ) aik shaam ya aik subha say ziyada nahi rahey .
